findings.evidence: The definition at line 134 copies `σ.partition.parts`, while the only API at lines 141–145 characterizes equality of two wrapped partitions, not the value of one.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem finPermPartition_parts ... : (finPermPartition n σ).parts = σ.partition.parts := rfl`.
findings.issue: `finPermPartition` is public but has no theorem exposing its `parts`; downstream users cannot characterize the opaque wrapper without unfolding it.

findings.evidence: Both statements reduce derived expressions (`μ.rowLens.sum` and equality of `finPermPartition` values) to canonical ones, and neither declaration has an automation attribute.
findings.fix: Mark both lemmas `@[simp]`; each is oriented from the new/derived representation to the existing canonical data.
findings.issue: The normal-form lemmas `sum_rowLens` and `finPermPartition_eq_iff` (line 141) are not tagged `@[simp]`, so routine reductions of the newly introduced API require manual rewrites.

summary: The sized permutation-partition wrapper lacks its basic characteristic lemma, and two normal-form results are missing simp annotations.
